name.value: PBF Pita Bread Factory Factory Outlet

description.value: The factory outlet of Bakestone Brothers, the Pita Bread Factory's consumer-facing brand, founded in 1984 by Fady Hayek from a single family pita recipe. Now a certified organic bakery producing a wide range of ethnic breads and baked goods including pita, bagels, naan, tortillas, and pretzels sold across Canada and parts of the US. A touring cyclist can pick up fresh bread products directly from the manufacturer at this outlet location.

raw_osm.name: PBF Pita Bread Factory Factory Outlet

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is the Bakestone Brothers operation run by the Pita Bread Factory, consistent with the OSM name 'PBF Pita Bread Factory Factory Outlet'. The phone number 604-528-6111 is confirmed on the website's Contact Us page. The website focuses on wholesale/retail bread products (pita, bagels, naan, tortillas) sold nationally, but the OSM record identifies a 'Factory Outlet' at this address suggesting direct retail sales; no amenity details (bike parking, washrooms, etc.) appear anywhere in the website content.
concerns: OSM name 'PBF Pita Bread Factory Factory Outlet' differs from the website brand name 'Bakestone Brothers'; the website does reference 'operated by the Pita Bread Factory' so these are the same entity under a rebranding.
Postal code V5A 2H5 corresponds to Burnaby, BC, not North Vancouver as listed in the OSM community field — address community may be miscategorized.
Website is primarily wholesale/manufacturing focused; it is unclear from the content how accessible or prominent the factory outlet retail component is to walk-in customers.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, operating bakery factory outlet selling fresh bread products; useful to touring cyclists as a place to resupply with baked goods directly from the manufacturer.
